snippet_primary: "Envato Elements is a subscription-based online marketplace for digital assets. Unlike Creative Market, you don't have to pay for each item individually to buy assets on this platform. Instead, you pay a single monthly subscription to get unlimited access to everything!"
subject_exact: DesignShack blog states Envato Elements uses a single monthly subscription model providing unlimited access to all assets, contrasted with Creative Market's per-item purchase model
local_qualifiers: Envato Elements: single monthly subscription for unlimited access to all assets
Creative Market: individual per-item purchase model
